nodes.name: accounts.py
nodes.body_text: """Account layer: persistent guest-account store + self-healing session pool. Why this exists --------------- The upstream allows one chat per XMPP stream, so throughput == number of live sessions. This module keeps a warm pool of logged-in guest accounts, reuses persisted credentials instead of registering new accounts on every restart, and replaces dead sessions in the background so a burst of requests does not all pay the ~2.8 s register+login cost. Layout ------ AccountStore : accounts.jsonl (username/password/device_id/jid/publictoken + counters) AccountFactory : provision() = reuse stored account, else register a brand-new guest SessionPool : min_idle warm sessions, max_size ceiling, background refill, retry """ from __future__ import annotations import json import os import threading import time from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field from channel_client import ChannelClient, ChannelError, rest @dataclass

nodes.body_text: class AccountStore: """Tiny append-only JSONL store (rewritten compactly on trim).""" def __init__(self, path: str = "accounts.jsonl"): self.path = path self._lock = threading.RLock() self._accounts: dict[str, Account] = {} self._in_use: set[str] = set() # usernames bound to a live session self._load() def _load(self) -> None: if not os.path.exists(self.path): return with open(self.path, encoding="utf-8") as fp: for line in fp: line = line.strip() if not line: continue try: data = json.loads(line) account = Account(**{k: v for k, v in data.items() if k in Account.__annotations__}) except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError): continue self._accounts[account.key()] = account def _flush(self) -> None: tmp = self.path + ".tmp" with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fp: for account in self._accounts.values(): fp.write(json.dumps(asdict(account), ensure_ascii=False) + "\n") os.replace(tmp, self.path) def upsert(self, account: Account) -> Account: with self._lock: self._accounts[account.key()] = account self._flush() return account def mark_used(self, username: str) -> None: with self._lock: account = self._accounts.get(username) if account: account.last_used = time.time() account.uses += 1 def mark_failed(self, username: str, reason: str = "", disable_after: int = 3) -> None: with self._lock: account = self._accounts.get(username) if not account: return account.fails += 1 account.note = reason[:200] if account.fails >= disable_after: account.disabled = True self._flush() def candidates(self, limit: int) -> list[Account]: """Least-recently-used, healthy, *not currently bound* accounts first.""" with self._lock: usable = [a for a in self._accounts.values() if not a.disabled and a.key() not in self._in_use] usable.sort(key=lambda a: (a.last_used or 0, a.created_at)) return usable[:limit] def reserve(self, username: str) -> bool: with self._lock: if username in self._in_use: return False self._in_use.add(username) return True def unreserve(self, username: str) -> None: with self._lock: self._in_use.discard(username) def bindings(self) -> list[str]: with self._lock: return sorted(self._in_use) def stats(self) -> dict: with self._lock: total = len(self._accounts) disabled = sum(1 for a in self._accounts.values() if a.disabled) bound = len(self._in_use) return {"stored": total, "disabled": disabled, "usable": total - disabled, "bound": bound, "free": total - disabled - bound}

nodes.body_text: class AccountFactory: """Creates / revives single accounts.""" def __init__(self, store: AccountStore, country: str = "US", verbose: bool = False, verify: bool = False, max_attempts: int = 3): self.store = store self.country = country self.verbose = verbose self.verify = verify self.max_attempts = max_attempts self.register_count = 0 self.revive_count = 0 self.last_error: str | None = None # ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers def _finish(self, client: ChannelClient, account: Account | None) -> Account: """Persist the account, then verify it over REST. Verification is a *health hint*, not a gate: the chat path is XMPP, so a flaky TLS handshake to the REST origin must not throw away a good account. Only an explicit 401/403 disables it. """ record = account or Account( username=client.username or "", password=client.password or "", device_id=client.device_id, jid=client.jid, publictoken=client.publictoken, country=self.country, ) record.jid = client.jid record.publictoken = client.publictoken record.disabled = False record.fails = 0 self.store.upsert(record) # persist first — never lose a live account if self.verify: status, payload = rest("/api/v2/currency/balances", client.jwt, client.jid, timeout=15, retries=1) if status in (401, 403): record.disabled = True record.note = f"verify rejected: {status} {payload}" self.store.upsert(record) client.close() raise ChannelError(f"account rejected by upstream: {status}") if status != 200: record.note = f"verify skipped (network): {status} {str(payload)[:120]}" self.store.upsert(record) if self.verbose: print(" ! verify skipped:", record.note) self.store.mark_used(record.username) return record # ----------------------------------------------------------------- public def new_client(self, reuse: Account | None = None) -> ChannelClient: """Return a logged-in client, reusing `reuse` when its credentials still work.""" if reuse is not None: try: client = ChannelClient(country=reuse.country or self.country, verbose=self.verbose) client.device_id = reuse.device_id client.username = reuse.username client.password = reuse.password client.connect() client.authenticate() # SASL only — no re-registration client._buf = "" client._send( "<?xml version='1.0'?>" f"<stream:stream to='x.siki.ai' xmlns='jabber:client' " f"xmlns:stream='http://etherx.jabber.org/streams' version='1.0'>" ) client._read_until(lambda b: "</stream:features>" in b, client.timeout) client.bind() client.fetch_vcard() client._send("<presence/>") client._drain(0.5) self.revive_count += 1 return client except Exception as exc: # noqa: BLE001 - fall through to a fresh account self.last_error = f"revive failed: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}" self.store.mark_failed(reuse.username, self.last_error) last_exc: Exception | None = None for attempt in range(1, self.max_attempts + 1): try: client = ChannelClient(country=self.country, verbose=self.verbose).login() self.register_count += 1 return client except Exception as exc: # noqa: BLE001 last_exc = exc self.last_error = f"register attempt {attempt}: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}" time.sleep(min(2.0 * attempt, 5.0)) raise ChannelError(f"cannot provision account: {last_exc}") def provision(self) -> tuple[ChannelClient, Account]: """One account per call: reserve a free stored account, else register a new one.""" reuse = None candidates = self.store.candidates(8) for candidate in candidates: if self.store.reserve(candidate.key()): reuse = candidate break try: client = self.new_client(reuse=reuse) except Exception: if reuse is not None: self.store.unreserve(reuse.key()) raise record = self._finish(client, reuse) self.store.reserve(record.key()) # new accounts get bound to this session too return client, record

nodes.body_text: class SessionPool: """Self-healing, auto-growing pool of logged-in sessions. * `min_idle` warm sessions kept ready by a background thread * `max_size` initial capacity (== how many chats run in parallel) * `hard_max` ceiling for autoscale; the pool grows when requests queue up * dead sessions are dropped and replaced transparently * registrations are rate-limited so a burst cannot hammer the upstream """ def __init__(self, max_size: int = 4, min_idle: int | None = None, store_path: str = "accounts.jsonl", country: str = "US", verbose: bool = False, acquire_timeout: float = 120.0, autoscale: bool = True, hard_max: int | None = None, grow_step: int = 2, max_registrations_per_min: int = 30): self.max_size = max(1, max_size) self.min_idle = self.max_size if min_idle is None else max(0, min(min_idle, self.max_size)) self.autoscale = autoscale self.hard_max = max(self.max_size, hard_max or max(self.max_size * 3, 12)) self.grow_step = max(1, grow_step) self.max_registrations_per_min = max(1, max_registrations_per_min) self._cap = self.max_size # current dynamic capacity self.store = AccountStore(store_path) self.factory = AccountFactory(self.store, country=country, verbose=verbose) self.acquire_timeout = acquire_timeout self._idle: list[ChannelClient] = [] self._total = 0 # live sessions (idle + busy + spawning) self._cv = threading.Condition() self._closed = False self._spawn_ts: list[float] = [] # registration rate limiter self._metrics = {"acquired": 0, "released": 0, "discarded": 0, "waited": 0, "spawn_errors": 0, "grown": 0, "spawn_ms": []} self._bindings: dict[int, str] = {} # id(client) -> account username self._maintainer = threading.Thread(target=self._maintain, name="pool-maintainer", daemon=True) self._maintainer.start() # ------------------------------------------------------------------ infra def _rate_limit_wait(self) -> None: """Keep registrations under `max_registrations_per_min` (protects the upstream).""" while True: now = time.time() with self._cv: self._spawn_ts = [ts for ts in self._spawn_ts if now - ts < 60] if len(self._spawn_ts) < self.max_registrations_per_min: self._spawn_ts.append(now) return sleep_for = 60 - (now - self._spawn_ts[0]) + 0.1 time.sleep(max(0.1, sleep_for)) def _create(self) -> ChannelClient: self._rate_limit_wait() started = time.time() try: client, record = self.factory.provision() with self._cv: self._bindings[id(client)] = record.key() finally: self._metrics["spawn_ms"].append(round((time.time() - started) * 1000, 1)) del self._metrics["spawn_ms"][:-200] return client def _spawn_one(self) -> None: try: client = self._create() except Exception: # noqa: BLE001 with self._cv: self._total -= 1 self._metrics["spawn_errors"] += 1 self._cv.notify() time.sleep(2.0) return with self._cv: if self._closed: client.close() self._total -= 1 self._metrics["discarded"] += 1 username = self._bindings.pop(id(client), None) if username: self.store.unreserve(username) else: self._idle.append(client) self._cv.notify() def _maintain(self) -> None: """Keep `min_idle` warm sessions available.""" while True: with self._cv: if self._closed: return need = self.min_idle - len(self._idle) can_spawn = self._cap - self._total slots = min(need, can_spawn) if slots <= 0: self._cv.wait(5.0) continue self._total += slots threads = [] for _ in range(slots): thread = threading.Thread(target=self._spawn_one, daemon=True) thread.start() threads.append(thread) for thread in threads: thread.join() def _grow_locked(self) -> int: """Raise capacity after queue pressure. Caller holds `_cv`.""" if not self.autoscale or self._cap >= self.hard_max: return 0 grown = min(self.grow_step, self.hard_max - self._cap) self._cap += grown self._metrics["grown"] += grown return grown # ----------------------------------------------------------------- public def prewarm(self, count: int | None = None, block: bool = True) -> dict: want = self.min_idle if count is None else count deadline = time.time() + (self.acquire_timeout if block else 0) while time.time() < deadline: with self._cv: if len(self._idle) >= want: return {"warm": len(self._idle), "cap": self._cap} time.sleep(0.25) with self._cv: return {"warm": len(self._idle), "cap": self._cap} def acquire(self, timeout: float | None = None) -> ChannelClient: """Hand out a validated session; register a new account when the pool must grow.""" timeout = self.acquire_timeout if timeout is None else timeout deadline = time.time() + timeout while True: with self._cv: waited = False client = None while True: if self._closed: raise ChannelError("pool closed") if self._idle: client = self._idle.pop() break if self._total < self._cap: self._total += 1 break # queue pressure -> autoscale (bounded by hard_max) grown = self._grow_locked() if grown: self._total += 1 break remaining = deadline - time.time() if remaining <= 0: raise ChannelError( f"account pool exhausted (cap={self._cap}, hard_max={self.hard_max})") waited = True self._cv.wait(min(remaining, 5.0)) if client is None: # slot re

nodes.body_text: def resolve_host(host: str = XMPP_HOST, port: int = XMPP_PORT) -> str: """Resolve `host`, falling back to DoH when the local resolver is hijacked. Local DNS on this box intermittently answers 127.0.0.1 for the upstream domains (see docs/ANALYSIS.md, "环境坑"), so a DoH lookup is used as a second opinion. """ override = os.environ.get("CHANNEL_HOST_IP") if override: return override try: infos = socket.getaddrinfo(host, port, socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) addrs = [info[4][0] for info in infos] if addrs and not all(a.startswith(("127.", "0.")) for a in addrs): return addrs[0] except OSError: pass for template in DOH_RESOLVERS: try: request = urllib.request.Request(template.format(host=host), headers={"accept": "application/dns-json"}) data = json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=10).read()) for answer in data.get("Answer") or []: if answer.get("type") == 1 and answer.get("data"): return answer["data"] except Exception: # noqa: BLE001 - try the next resolver continue raise ChannelError(f"cannot resolve {host}")

Patching getaddrinfo for just that host is the smallest hammer that keeps SNI/Host correct. """ if not bot_jid.endswith("@" + XMPP_HOST): bot_jid = f"{bot_jid}@{XMPP_HOST}" started = time.time() cleaned = (text.replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">")) with self._lock: self._buf = "" stanza_id = str(uuid.uuid4()) # the AI worker ignores non-UUID ids self._send( f"<message id='{stanza_id}' to='{bot_jid}' type='chat'>" f"<publictoken xmlns='proximity:publictoken'>{self.publictoken or ''}</publictoken>" f"<body>{cleaned}</body>" "<request xmlns='urn:xmpp:receipts'/>" f"<active xmlns='{NS_CHATSTATES}'/>" "<nick xmlns='http://jabber.org/protocol/nick'>Guest</nick>" "</message>" ) parts: list[str] = [] images: list[dict] = [] thinking = False balance = None seen: set[str] = set() seen_images: set[str] = set() first_token_ms = None answered = False last_data = time.time() while time.time() - started < max_seconds: if answered and time.time() - last_data >= quiet: break self.sock.settimeout(1.0) try: chunk = self.sock.recv(65536) except socket.timeout: continue except OSError as exc: raise ChannelError(f"read failed: {exc}") from exc if not chunk: raise ChannelError("stream closed by server") piece = chunk.decode("utf-8", "replace") self._log("<<", piece) self._buf += piece last_data = time.time() for new_part in _extract_parts(piece, bot_jid, seen): parts.append(new_part) answered = True if first_token_ms is None: first_token_ms = round((time.time() - started) * 1000, 1) if on_part is not None: on_part(new_part, round(time.time() - started, 2)) if "<thinking" in piece or "<composing" in piece: thinking = True for image in _scan_images(self._buf): key = image.get("url") or str(image.get("wrapper")) if key not in seen_images: seen_images.add(key) images.append(image) if image.get("url"): answered = True bal = _extract_balance(piece) if bal: balance = bal self._buf = self._buf[-8000:] self._respond_pings() raw = self._buf self._buf = "" self._respond_pings() if not parts and not any(image.get("url") for image in images): raise ChannelError(f"no reply from {bot_jid} within {max_seconds:.0f}s") return Reply( text="\n".join(parts), parts=parts, images=images, thinking=thinking, elapsed=round(time.time() - started, 2), first_token_ms=first_token_ms, raw=raw, balance=balance, )

nodes.body_text: class AccountPool: """Pool of logged-in guest accounts; holds at most `size` live XMPP sessions.""" def __init__(self, size: int = 2, country: str = "US", verbose: bool = False): if size < 1: raise ValueError("size must be >= 1") self.size = size self.country = country self.verbose = verbose self._idle: list[ChannelClient] = [] self._total = 0 self._cv = threading.Condition() self._closed = False self.created = 0 self.reused = 0 def acquire(self, timeout: float = 90.0) -> ChannelClient: with self._cv: deadline = time.time() + timeout while True: if self._closed: raise ChannelError("pool closed") if self._idle: self.reused += 1 return self._idle.pop() if self._total < self.size: self._total += 1 break remaining = deadline - time.time() if remaining <= 0: raise ChannelError("account pool exhausted") self._cv.wait(remaining) try: client = ChannelClient(country=self.country, verbose=self.verbose).login() except Exception: with self._cv: self._total -= 1 self._cv.notify() raise self.created += 1 return client def release(self, client: ChannelClient) -> None: healthy = client.sock is not None with self._cv: if healthy and not self._closed: self._idle.append(client) else: self._total -= 1 client.close() self._cv.notify() def discard(self, client: ChannelClient) -> None: with self._cv: self._total -= 1 self._cv.notify() client.close() def stats(self) -> dict: with self._cv: return { "pool_size": self.size, "live_sessions": self._total, "idle": len(self._idle), "accounts_created": self.created, "reused": self.reused, "jids": [c.jid for c in self._idle], } def shutdown(self) -> None: with self._cv: self._closed = True idle, self._idle = self._idle, [] for client in idle: client.close()

Run: python -X utf8 demo_server.py [--port 8920] [--pool 2] Endpoints GET / web demo page GET /health liveness + pool snapshot GET /stats request metrics GET /v1/models bots exposed as chat models GET /api/categories catalog categories GET /api/bots?q=&type=&limit= bot directory (character | image) GET /api/showcase showcase prompts + images POST /api/accounts create a fresh guest account (jid/jwt/publictoken/balances) GET /api/accounts/<jid>/balances POST /v1/chat/completions {model, messages, stream} -> OpenAI chat completion POST /v1/images/generations {model, prompt} -> best-effort image bot request """ from __future__ import annotations import argparse import gzip import json import os import threading import time import traceback import urllib.error import urllib.parse import urllib.request import uuid from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer from accounts import AccountFactory, SessionPool from channel_client import ChannelClient, ChannelError, Catalog, Reply, rest VERSION = "0.1.0" STARTED = time.time() POOL: SessionPool | None = None FACTORY: AccountFactory | None = None STATS_LOCK = threading.Lock() STATS = { "requests": 0, "chat_ok": 0, "chat_error": 0, "image_requests": 0, "accounts_created": 0, "latencies_ms": [], } ACCOUNTS: dict[str, str] = {} # bare jid -> jwt, for balance lookups API_KEY = os.environ.get("CHANNEL_API_KEY", "") # --------------------------------------------------------------- bot helpers _BOT_INDEX: dict[str, dict] = {} _BOT_INDEX_AT = 0.0 # ------------------------------------------------------------------- handler if __name__ == "__main__": main()

nodes.name: resolve_bot
nodes.body_text: def resolve_bot(model: str) -> dict: """Resolve a bot by username / bare JID / display name. Username-shaped ids (`0_…`, `pt_…`) are matched strictly — a fuzzy upstream search there would happily return an unrelated bot instead of a 404. """ key = (model or "").strip() catalog_ok = True try: index = bot_index() except Exception: # noqa: BLE001 - CDN down must not break chatting by username index, catalog_ok = {}, False bot = index.get(key) or index.get(key.lower()) if bot is not None: return bot if key.startswith(("0_", "pt_")): local = key.split("@")[0] # Structurally-valid bot ids (0_<uuid> / pt_<uuid>) are forwarded to the # upstream even when the CDN catalog snapshot misses them: the catalog is # eventually-consistent and a refresh race must not 404 a bot the XMPP # layer would happily answer. Malformed ids (not a uuid) still 404 fast. try: uuid.UUID(local.split("_", 1)[1]) except (ValueError, IndexError): if catalog_ok and index: raise KeyError(model) # index is healthy -> the id really is unknown return {"username": local, "bare_jid": f"{local}@x.siki.ai", "display_name": local, "config_type": "character", "can_generate_text": True, "interactions": None} if not key: raise KeyError(model) for item in Catalog.search(key, limit=5): if (item.get("display_name") or "").lower() == key.lower(): return item hits = Catalog.search(key, limit=1) if hits and hits[0].get("can_generate_text"): return hits[0] raise KeyError(model)

nodes.body_text: def read_until(self, marker: str, timeout: float = 25.0) -> str: deadline = time.time() + timeout while marker not in self.buf: left = deadline - time.time() if left <= 0: raise TimeoutError(marker) self.sock.settimeout(left) chunk = self.sock.recv(65536) if not chunk: raise ConnectionError("stream closed") self.buf += chunk.decode("utf-8", "replace") out, self.buf = self.buf, "" return out

nodes.name: pump
nodes.body_text: def pump(c, seconds, quiet=3.0): out, chunks = "", [] t0 = last = time.time() while time.time() - t0 < seconds: c.sock.settimeout(1) try: chunk = c.sock.recv(65536) except Exception: if time.time() - last > quiet and out: break continue if not chunk: break text = chunk.decode("utf-8", "replace") out += text chunks.append((round(time.time() - t0, 2), text)) last = time.time() return out, chunks

nodes.name: call
nodes.signature: def call(base: str, path: str, payload=None, timeout: float = 240.0, raw: bool = False)
nodes.body_text: def call(base: str, path: str, payload=None, timeout: float = 240.0, raw: bool = False): data = None if payload is None else json.dumps(payload).encode() request = urllib.request.Request(base + path, data=data, headers=_headers(), method="POST" if data is not None else "GET") started = time.time() try: with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=timeout) as resp: body = resp.read() return resp.status, (body.decode() if raw else json.loads(body)), time.time() - started except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc: body = exc.read().decode() try: parsed = json.loads(body) except json.JSONDecodeError: parsed = body return exc.code, parsed, time.time() - started

In one short sentence, who are you?", "And what did I just ask you?", ][:turns]): status, data, elapsed = call(base, "/v1/chat/completions", {"model": bot["id"], "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}]}) content = "" if status == 200: content = data.get("choices", [{}])[0].get("message", {}).get("content", "") ok = ok and status == 200 and len(content) > 3 latencies.append(elapsed * 1000) first_tokens.append(data.get("x_channel", {}).get("first_token_ms") if status == 200 else None) print(f" turn{index+1}: {elapsed*1000:.0f}ms first_token={first_tokens[-1]}ms -> {content[:70]!r}") check("serial chat ok", ok, f"median={statistics.median(latencies):.0f}ms first_token={first_tokens[0]}ms")

nodes.body_text: def scenario_concurrency(base, bots, concurrency): print(f"\n[5] 并发 x{concurrency}") if not bots: return check("concurrency", False, "no bot") hot = sorted(bots, key=lambda b: -(b.get("interactions") or 0)) pool = hot[:max(concurrency, 1)] or bots results = [] lock = threading.Lock() def worker(index): bot = pool[index % len(pool)] status, data, elapsed = call(base, "/v1/chat/completions", {"model": bot["id"], "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": f"ping {index}, reply one word"}]}, timeout=240) with lock: results.append((status, elapsed, data.get("choices", [{}])[0].get("message", {}).get("content", "") if status == 200 else str(data)[:80])) threads = [threading.Thread(target=worker, args=(i,)) for i in range(concurrency)] started = time.time() for thread in threads: thread.start() for thread in threads: thread.join() wall = time.time() - started ok = (len(results) == concurrency and all(status == 200 and len(content) > 1 for status, _elapsed, content in results)) detail = f"wall={wall:.1f}s max={max(r[1] for r in results):.1f}s" if not ok: detail += " | " + "; ".join(f"{status}:{content[:40]}" for status, _elapsed, content in results) check(f"concurrent x{concurrency}", ok, detail)

nodes.body_text: def collect(c, seconds): out = "" t0 = time.time() while time.time() - t0 < seconds: c.sock.settimeout(2) try: chunk = c.sock.recv(65536) except Exception: continue if not chunk: break out += chunk.decode("utf-8", "replace") c.buf += out return out

nodes.signature: def pick(bots: list[dict], count: int) -> list[dict]
nodes.body_text: def pick(bots: list[dict], count: int) -> list[dict]: """高人气 + 随机抽样，兼顾'热门是否可用'与'冷门是否可用'。""" hot = sorted(bots, key=lambda b: -(b.get("interaction_count") or b.get("interactions") or 0)) hot = hot[: max(1, count // 2)] rest = [b for b in bots if b not in hot] random.seed(20261029) cold = random.sample(rest, min(len(rest), count - len(hot))) return hot + cold

对话抽查：{ok}/{len(results)} 成功，wall {wall:.1f}s，" f"首字节中位 {sorted(firsts)[len(firsts)//2] if firsts else '—'} ms") image_result = None if args.image and images: bot = sorted(images, key=lambda b: -(b.get("interaction_count") or 0))[0] print(f"

nodes.body_text: """Minimal XMPP client for x.siki.ai (Channel app backend). Flow mirrored from the APK (_legacy/xmpp/*.java): TLS(443, direct TLS) -> guest registration IQ (jabber:iq:register) -> SASL PLAIN -> bind -> IQ proximity:jwt:token -> message to bot JID """ import base64 import hashlib import socket import ssl import time import uuid HOST = "x.siki.ai" PORT = 443 NS_STREAM = "http://etherx.jabber.org/streams" if __name__ == "__main__": c = XmppClient() try: print("=== stream features ===") c.connect() print("\n=== guest registration ===") iq_id, username, password, resp = c.register_guest(country="US") print("\nRESULT:", resp[-600:]) print("username:", username, "password:", password) finally: try: c.sock.close() except Exception: pass

nodes.name: XmppClient
nodes.body_text: class XmppClient: def __init__(self, host=HOST, port=PORT, verbose=True): self.host = host self.port = port self.verbose = verbose self.buf = "" self.log = [] # ---------------- transport ---------------- def connect(self): raw = socket.create_connection((self.host, self.port), timeout=20) ctx = ssl.create_default_context() ctx.check_hostname = False ctx.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_NONE self.sock = ctx.wrap_socket(raw, server_hostname=self.host) self.sock.settimeout(30) self.send( "<?xml version='1.0'?>" f"<stream:stream to='{self.host}' xmlns='jabber:client' " f"xmlns:stream='{NS_STREAM}' version='1.0'>" ) return self.read_until("</stream:features>", timeout=15) def send(self, xml): self.log.append((">>", xml)) if self.verbose: print(">>", xml[:400]) self.sock.sendall(xml.encode()) def read_until(self, marker, timeout=30): deadline = time.time() + timeout while marker not in self.buf: left = deadline - time.time() if left <= 0: raise TimeoutError(f"timeout waiting {marker!r}; buffer={self.buf[-800:]}") self.sock.settimeout(left) chunk = self.sock.recv(65536) if not chunk: raise ConnectionError("stream closed; buffer=" + self.buf[-800:]) text = chunk.decode("utf-8", "replace") self.buf += text self.log.append(("<<", text)) if self.verbose: print("<<", text[:400]) return self.buf def take(self, marker="__never__"): """Return and clear the buffer (optionally up to marker).""" out, self.buf = self.buf, "" return out # ---------------- protocol ---------------- def register_guest(self, country="US", device_id=None, resource="android"): """Guest in-band registration, per RegistrationActivity.initGuestRegistration().""" device_id = device_id or uuid.uuid4().hex nonce = str(uuid.uuid4()) formatted = f"{country}.{''.join(ch for ch in (device_id + nonce) if ch.isdigit())}" username = f"tmp_{country}_{md5(formatted)}".lower() # device_id + uuid may contain letters; app keeps only digits via Regex("[^\\d.]") password = md5(device_id) iq_id = str(uuid.uuid4()) packet = ( f"<iq id='{iq_id}' type='set'>" "<query xmlns='jabber:iq:register'>" f"<username>{username}</username>" f"<password>{password}</password>" f"<verificationcode>sc:{device_id}</verificationcode>" f"<resource>{resource}</resource>" "</query></iq>" ) self.send(packet) return iq_id, username, password, self.read_until("</iq>", timeout=25) def sasl_plain(self, username, password): """SASL PLAIN; the success element may carry the API JWT in a `jwt` attribute.""" import re token = base64.b64encode(f"\x00{username}\x00{password}".encode()).decode() self.buf = "" self.send(f"<auth xmlns='urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:xmpp-sasl' mechanism='PLAIN'>{token}</auth>") self.read_until("<success", timeout=20) match = re.search(r"jwt='([^']+)'", self.buf) self.jwt = match.group(1) if match else None if self.verbose and self.jwt: print("<< jwt:", self.jwt[:60], "...") return self.buf def open_stream_again(self): self.buf = "" self.send( "<?xml version='1.0'?>" f"<stream:stream to='{self.host}' xmlns='jabber:client' " f"xmlns:stream='{NS_STREAM}' version='1.0'>" ) return self.read_until("</stream:features>", timeout=15) def bind(self, resource="android"): iq_id = "bind-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8] self.buf = "" self.send( f"<iq id='{iq_id}' type='set'><bind xmlns='urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:xmpp-bind'>" f"<resource>{resource}</resource></bind></iq>" ) return self.read_until(f"id='{iq_id}'", timeout=20) def get_jwt(self): iq_id = "jwt-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8] self.buf = "" self.send( f"<iq type='get' id='{iq_id}'><query xmlns='proximity:jwt:token'/></iq>" ) return self.read_until(f"id='{iq_id}'", timeout=20)
